title: Codex session tool usage statistics -- 551 sessions analyzed
desc: Which tools Codex actually calls, ranked by frequency. Key input for harness coverage planning.
steps: SESSION FILES: C:/Users/kiexp/.codex/sessions/**/*.jsonl (550 files) + history.jsonl. Total 21308 tool calls.
TOOL TIER: shell_command 18463 (86.6%), apply_patch 1823 (8.6%), web_search 264 (1.2%), _search/_fetch_file 320 (1.5%), MCP github 200 (0.9%).
SHELL BREAKDOWN (18462 calls): Get-Content 4638, git 2347, wkappbot 2089, Get-ChildItem 1962, rg 1694, Select-String 680, python 392, dotnet 338, gh 114.
KEY INSIGHT: Codex does NOT use write_file/read_file natively. Writes = apply_patch. Reads = Get-Content via shell. Blocking apply_patch + routing shell_command covers 95pct of tool calls.
PARSE: response_item + payload.type=function_call -> payload.name=tool. custom_tool_call -> payload.name=apply_patch. mcp_tool_call_end -> payload.invocation.tool.
RE-RUN ANALYSIS: python3 + glob.glob on .codex/sessions/**/*.jsonl + json.loads per line + Counter on payload.name.
